title: ReconViaGen: Accurate Multi-view 3D Reconstruction via Generation
summary: ReconViaGen is a 3D reconstruction framework that combines reconstruction and generative priors to create accurate models from sparse views. It integrates VGGT for pose-free reconstruction and TRELLIS for high-fidelity 3D generation, effectively eliminating hallucinations while preserving input details.
research_notes: Optimized for consumer GPUs (24GB VRAM); supports exporting to GLB and Gaussian Splatting formats.

evolution.summary: The project evolved with a major v0.5 update integrating TRELLIS 2, enabling high-resolution mesh generation and PBR material support. It remains active as a research project from GAP-LAB (CUHK-Shenzhen) submitted to ICLR 2026.
